stem: Which monitoring practice gives the strongest basis for detecting a meaningful source-water change over time?
choices: Sample after visible crop stress appears, using the nearest available tap and the same handheld meter
Use a consistent sampling point and method, verify instruments, and compare pH and EC with prior trends
Rotate sampling locations through the facility so each reading represents a different part of the water system
Record the final nutrient solution after mixing and infer source-water changes from the finished tank values
rationale: Trend interpretation is strongest when measurements are collected consistently with verified instruments. Consistent source-water records help distinguish real changes from sampling or measurement variation.
